subject.title: [Bug]: Dreaming deep promotion biased to stale 3-5 day old content; REM produces repetitive meta-themes; promotion gates bypassed via phase-signal boost

question: For deep Dreaming promotion, should minRecallCount and minUniqueQueries require explicit recall/query evidence, or may daily/session/grounded signals and recall-day diversity continue to satisfy those gates?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally allow daily-only promotion, while multiple user reports show that policy can promote stale or structural noise into durable memory; automation cannot choose the durable-memory policy safely.

options.title: Define a signal contract first
options.body: Recommended: decide the recall/daily/grounded/query-day policy, then align ranking, apply, docs, diagnostics, and tests in one focused follow-up.

options.title: Keep daily-only promotion with guards
options.body: Preserve the current promotion semantics but prioritize anti-contamination fixes such as placeholder filtering and better REM/session-corpus denoising.

options.title: Split and close the umbrella later
options.body: Continue tracking each narrow issue separately and close this umbrella only after the open slices have merged or been intentionally rejected.

recommendation.title: Define a signal contract first
recommendation.body: Recommended: decide the recall/daily/grounded/query-day policy, then align ranking, apply, docs, diagnostics, and tests in one focused follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent commits place vincentkoc closest to the active promotion gate and daily-only promotion semantics that need the policy decision.
